recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change current core source or reintroduce XPath for FHIR-13236; any historical STU3 Schematron concern belongs to a versioned technical-correction process outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-13236 was a Published OO change request for STU3, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to fix Observation invariant obs-7 because the XPath/Schematron form could fail Observations with value[x] and no matching component code.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-13236. Historical Observation spreadsheet history shows the same obs-7 area was updated in 2017 by commit 311839957674a44444b3876d8e7a24662b624742 for GF#14073, changing the expression to a coding-level component-code comparison; the source was later migrated to StructureDefinition XML, and commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 removed checked-in XPath constraints entirely.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later related issues clarified obs-7 wording (FHIR-38955) and condition flags (FHIR-20521), while Zulip discussion confirms the reported failure was a historical STU3 Schematron problem. Confluence and direct FHIR-13236 community searches found no contrary evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source expression value.empty() or component.code.where(coding.intersect(%resource.code.coding).exists()).empty() matches the intended truth table and the obsolete XPath surface is absent.
